title: Rate of Pursuit Computation Worksheet - Education Benefits
content:
**Computation worksheet — the rate of pursuit confirmed for a verified month, Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).**

**Line 1 — the certification measured.** The rate of pursuit the student confirms for a verified month is worked out on the student's resident term certification: the latest certification on the benefit, by term start, whose courses are not all distance learning.

**Line 2 — the credits.** The credit hours certified on that resident term certification.

**Line 3 — the divisor.** The full-time standard of the tier: the credit hours that make full time for an undergraduate standard term, 12 credit hours.

**Line 4 — the rate.** Line 2 divided by Line 3, the result multiplied by 100, rounded half up to a whole percent, and never set above 100 percent. The rounding is made once, on the final percentage.

| Line | Content | Source on the records |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Resident term certification | Latest certification on the benefit not wholly by distance learning |
| 2 | Credit hours | Credits certified on that certification |
| 3 | Full-time standard | 12 credit hours |
| 4 | Rate of pursuit confirmed | Line 2 divided by Line 3, times 100, rounded half up, at most 100 |

**Worked figures (hypothetical certifications).**

| Credits certified | Line 2 divided by Line 3 | Times 100 | Rate confirmed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | 0.75 | 75 | 75 percent |
| 10 | 0.8333 | 83.33 | 83 percent |
| 7 | 0.5833 | 58.33 | 58 percent |
| 15 | 1.25 | 125 | 100 percent (never above 100) |
